title: Teens Realize Cops Discovered Their Sick Secret

beats.description: Dramatic opening with family reacting to news that someone intentionally caused the act, then narrator sets up the fatal rock-throwing incident.
Narrator describes the crash scene, Alexa's death, and initial investigation revealing multiple rock-strike victims on the same road.
Dash cam footage from a victim is reviewed; deputies discuss parallels to a 2017 Michigan rock-throwing murder and the possibility of teenage perpetrators.
Tip from teenager JB identifies three suspects: Joseph Kanig, Nicholas 'Mitch' Carroll, and Zachary Quac; they were seen loading rocks at Walmart.
Coordinated arrests of all three teens: Mitch agrees to come in, Joe's father obstructs leading to both being handcuffed, Zach is taken from his home.
Narrator transitions to interrogations, noting Joe invokes his right to a lawyer.
Mitch's interrogation: he blames Zach for throwing all rocks, describes Zach's excitement. Zach's interrogation: he denies throwing rocks, claims Joe was the thrower.
Narrator reveals Mitch and Joe had a prior incident throwing a statue head at cars; Mitch admits he lied to protect Joe.
Zach describes the fatal throw: Joe threw the rock, they circled back to take a photo of the crashed car, and said 'blood brothers.' All three are charged with first-degree murder.
Nine months later, Mitch revises his statement under a plea agreement, now admitting all three threw rocks but still claiming Zach threw the fatal one.
Prosecutor reads that Mitch's attorneys stated Joe threw the fatal rock; Mitch struggles with memory but eventually says he believes it was Zach.
Narrator details plea deals and trial: Mitch and Zach testify against Joe. Mitch confidently states Joe threw the fatal rock.
Sentences announced: Mitch 45 years, Zach 32 years, Joe life without parole plus 60 years. Joe's father's obstruction charge unconfirmed.
Narrator shares Alexa's mother's tribute and channel promotion for Patreon and memberships.
